description: This source file defines the main route component for the '/index' page of a Remix-based React application, implementing a note-taking interface with functionality for loading, creating, editing, deleting, filtering, and exporting notes. It also manages client-side state, integrates with server-side loaders and actions, and renders the user interface for the note organizer.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines meta tags for the page, setting the title and description.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches initial data for the page, including user info and search query parameters.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for deleting notes; supports other intentions.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Main React component rendering the note-taking UI, managing state and interactions.

methods.name: handleNew
methods.description: Creates and activates a new empty note for editing.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current note, either creating a new one or updating an existing note.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Exports the active note as a plain text file.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a tag for filtering.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the list of available tags and assigns it to the current note.
